name: softicon-live-chat
description: Self-hosted live chat for WordPress: a light chat widget for visitors and an inbox in wp-admin, no account or external service

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-live-chat.zip && printf '→ Building
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-live-chat/softicon-live-chat.zip softicon-live-chat/softicon-live-chat.php softicon-live-chat/uninstall.php softicon-live-chat/index.php softicon-live-chat/includes softicon-live-chat/src softicon-live-chat/build softicon-live-chat/languages softicon-live-chat/readme.txt softicon-live-chat/wpml-config.xml softicon-live-chat/package.json softicon-live-chat/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-live-chat.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-live-chat.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-live-chat.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
